selection_reasoning: These three tasks form a coherent exploration-and-mining chain through a decorated structure. The player first locates a torch which illuminates a corridor, then follows the nether brick slab path/floor deeper into the structure, and finally reaches and mines a jack_o_lantern at the end. The torch serves as a navigational beacon leading toward the nether brick area, and the nether brick slab area guides the player to where the jack_o_lantern is placed. This creates a natural spatial dependency where each discovery leads to the next, culminating in a mining action.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near a torch (at spawn-relative [0, 2, 5]) and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. max_distance=16 allows detection from the corridor entrance; facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the torch.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The target is the center of the nether brick slab floor deeper in the corridor (spawn-relative [0, -1, 12]). max_distance=8 forces the player to walk into the corridor past the entrance torches before this triggers, enforcing sequential discovery. facing_tolerance=180 (no facing requirement) since the slabs are underfoot and looking down shouldn't be required.

Uses inventory_has because mining a jack_o_lantern causes it to drop itself as an item which enters the player's inventory. This is the most reliable check for a mine task — having the item proves the block was successfully mined and picked up.

scene_description: A fully enclosed nether brick corridor extending ~16 blocks from the player spawn. The corridor has nether brick walls and ceiling, with a nether brick slab floor. Torches are placed at the entrance and along the walls to guide the player. A jack_o_lantern sits at the far end of the corridor on the floor, serving as the final mining target.
task_text: Navigate the nether brick corridor: first find a torch near the entrance, then observe the nether brick slab floor, and finally mine the jack_o_lantern at the end of the corridor.
design_notes: Player spawns at ~0 ~1 ~0 facing the corridor entrance at z=3. Torches at z=3 and z=5 (entrance), z=10 and z=14 (mid-corridor). Nether brick slab floor from z=4 to z=19. Jack_o_lantern at z=18 on the floor. Player given wooden pickaxe to mine the jack_o_lantern. No night vision — torches provide natural lighting. Corridor is 5 blocks wide (interior), 4 blocks tall.
